## <img src="./assets/icon-about.svg" width="24" height="24" alt="" /> About me

Exploring AI product management by building useful things.

I&#x27;m Ethan. I use AI to turn ideas into practical products, and I&#x27;m developing my approach to AI product management through hands-on projects.

I&#x27;m interested in the decisions between a promising demo and a useful product: whose problem to solve, what to build first, where AI helps, and how to tell whether the result works. This space brings together my projects, product thinking, and writing.

### What I care about

- <img src="./assets/icon-about.svg" width="16" height="16" alt="" /> **Start with the problem.** Understand the user and the task before choosing the model or tool.
- <img src="./assets/icon-work.svg" width="16" height="16" alt="" /> **Make ideas tangible.** Build a focused prototype to explore the experience and its trade-offs.
- <img src="./assets/icon-writing.svg" width="16" height="16" alt="" /> **Learn from evidence.** Use feedback and evaluation to decide what to improve next.
